text:
elaine: Installed upgrade via Homebrew, `redwoodctl` v0.12.3. `redwoodctl install` ok, but `redwoodctl login` errors out:
```
$ redwoodctl login
Error: failed to create config dir "/Users/elaine/.config/redwood": permission denied
```

sasha: Sounds like postinstall didn't create the dir or set ownership. saw similar on M1s when brew upgraded without running postinstall properly.

matt: Can you share `ls -la ~/.config` and `getfacl ~/.config`? ACLs often cause surprises after user transfers.

elaine: `ls -la` shows `drwxr-xr-x  3 elaine staff 96 Mar 23 09:12 .config`. getfacl not present on mac, but `ls -le` shows some ACL entries for root from an old migration.

jonah: Quick unblock: `mkdir -p ~/.config/redwood && sudo chown $(id -u):$(id -g) ~/.config/redwood` — or avoid sudo if you can create as user. After that `redwoodctl login` should prompt as normal.

elaine: Confirmed that creates dir and login works. Onboarding test passes now.

matt: Action items: 1) fix Homebrew formula postinstall to ensure directory is created and owned by invoking user's uid/gid; 2) make `redwoodctl login` surface a friendly error with suggested mkdir/chown and a link to docs; 3) add a macOS installer upgrade e2e that simulates ACL ownership mismatch.

sasha: Also add a short doc blurb under macOS troubleshooting for migrations and a one-liner workaround. New users hit this during guided onboarding.

brew-bot: Homebrew test job 4521 queued (installer-upgrade-perms).

ci-bot: added CI reproducer for ACL case, job 7810.

matt: I'll open PRs for formula and CLI error text. tagging @sasha for doc update and @jonah for test harness.

elaine: thanks — saved my afternoon. :coffee:
